datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Select which Sitadel datasets to extract

departementCodes.title: Département codes
departementCodes.description: Filter by département codes (e.g. ['75', '13', '69']). Leave empty for all.

communeInseeCodes.title: Commune INSEE codes
communeInseeCodes.description: Filter by commune INSEE codes. Leave empty for all.

dateAutorisationFrom.title: Authorization date from
dateAutorisationFrom.description: Filter permits from this date (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD)

dateAutorisationTo.title: Authorization date to
dateAutorisationTo.description: Filter permits until this date (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD)

minSurfaceHab.title: Minimum habitable surface (m²)
minSurfaceHab.description: Minimum habitable surface in square meters

onlyPersonnesMorales.title: Only legal entities (RGPD compliant)
onlyPersonnesMorales.description: Only export permits where the applicant is a legal entity (has SIREN). This is the RGPD-compliant default for lead generation.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only new since last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Only extract permits that are newer than the last run (uses key-value store watermark)

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of permits to extract (leave empty for unlimited)

includeFields.title: Field selection
includeFields.description: Choose between minimal (lead-oriented) or full fields

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Preview mode returns only aggregate counts (free); Extract mode exports full permits (paid per permit)
